title: Representation theory of the Gelfand quiver and Harish-Chandra modules for $\mathsf{SL}_2(\mathbb{R})$
summary: In 1970, Gelfand posed the problem of classifying the indecomposable objects in a representation category equivalent to the principal block of Harish-Chandra modules for $\mathsf{SL}_2(\mathbb{R})$; explicit solutions were obtained by Bondarenko, and, independently, Crawley-Boevey. In this article, we give a complete answer to Gelfand's problem from a derived category perspective.
